arStrings.szText:
For every {c_number}[SF_2 * 100|%|]{/c} Life you are missing, you gain {c_random}[SF_1 * 100|%x|]{/c} increased damage and {c_number}[SF_3 * 100|%|]{/c} damage reduction.

Each Resource you spend also drains {c_number}[SF_4 * 100|1%|]{/c} of your Maximum Life to refund {c_number}[SF_9 * 100|%|]{/c} of the total Resources spent. This cannot reduce you to below {c_number}[SF_5 * 100|%|]{/c} Life.
Earn by defeating Bartuc within the Infernal Hordes in Torment I or higher.
